title: skills(objectstack-ui, query, automation): stop teaching assigned_to / assignee as the record owner beside owner_id (follow-up of #33506)
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up owed by work in flight). PR #33555 (card #33506) teaches in objectstack-data that a request's owner, assignee, 负责人 or 处理人 maps to the injected `owner_id`, and that a separate handler field must carry a label no other field on the object uses. Its at-tier contract review found the other skills still teach the opposite, so an agent loading both gets conflicting teaching and the #33506 staging shape (two 「负责人」 columns) is prevented for the data skill only.

## Where (measured on `main` `8e63ed87`)

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` line 60: `{ field: 'assigned_to', label: 'Owner' }`, a second field carrying the injected owner's label; line 101 filters "mine" on `assigned_to`; lines 265 and 270 use `assignee`.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` eval 1 answers the prompt word "owner" with `assigned_to`; eval 12 repeats the filter.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` line 44 takes `assigned_to` as a param.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` line 268, `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` lines 290 to 292, `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` line 116: `assignee` used as the owner.
- After #33555 the ui examples and eval 1 name a `support_case.assigned_to` the data template no longer declares.

## What lands

Point each to `owner_id` where the owner is meant (label 「负责人」 / Owner is the injected one), or, where a separate handler is genuinely meant, keep it with a label that does not collide and say it grants no access. One cross-reference to the objectstack-data rule, no restatement. Evals updated to match. `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset.

## Scope

`skills/**` only. `Clause-②: no`.

Blocked-by: #33506 (PR #33555)
